snippet.title: Paperly 2 | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
A relaxing paper plane adventure where gravity is your only engine and your wings carry the color. Dive for speed, skim the ground, and paint faded low-poly worlds back to life. Fly with a friend in online co-op, drift in Free Fly, or race pilots worldwide. 

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851650/Paperly_Paper_Plane_Adventure
